title: The Growth Marketing + AI Stack
subtitle: Ten go-to-market folders, first touch to final report. Every item running in production today.

kinds.agent: AI seats that hold a growth role: strategy, media buying, editing, analysis, review.
kinds.skill: Repeatable playbooks an agent loads on demand: voice, video, QR, data rules, audits.
kinds.loop: Scheduled jobs that run daily or weekly with no one pressing a button.
kinds.automation: Always-on systems: AI answering, consent register, cockpit, classroom.
